outfit) Wow, that's a beautiful skirt, Gloria.

I’m not comfortable saying. LUKE Is it you? PHIL No. LUKE Then it’s gotta be Mom. PHIL Drop that, okay. Look, Mom and I are a team and we both think of this as a chance for you to show some responsibility. Don’t make us look like jerks here. LUKE I won’t.

Thirty minutes after he made a promise to me, he left his bike unlocked.

All I could hear was Claire’s voice in my head: that sounds nothing like Claire) “He’s not responsible. You never should have given him a bike.” I know, I do a pretty good Claire. PHIL (V.O.) So I decided to teach him a lesson and let him think his bike was stolen. I know it sounds kinda rough but sometimes a Dad’s job is to be the tough guy. PHIL (CONT’D) Excuse me! On your left! DANIELLE Everyone, we have a new friend joining us today. Lily. And these are her parents.
Hey.
Oh, I do it all the time. Don’t be embarrassed.
“You stay away from that homewrecker. She’ll seduce you. You’re too handsome.” Do I find her attractive? Yes. Would I ever act on it? No. No way. Not while my wife is still alive.

“I’m very proud of you, Phil. You showed tremendous self-control.” That’s Claire as a ghost.

The good news is, Luke has his bike. More good news, I taught some random kid a valuable lesson by stealing his bike.

So, I figure I’ll just dump the new bike where I stole the first one. That way, random kid gets his back, and the new bike doesn’t raise a lot of embarrassing questions like why I had it or who boosted who through a bedroom window. Everybody’s happy. JAY Son of a -- you gave me the wrong screwdriver. MANNY Maybe you’re just using it wrong. My dad’s great with tools. He can get the wheels off a car in less than a minute. MANNY (CONT’D) Ow! JAY Sorry. MANNY
I just love ya so darn much!

So, all’s well that ends well. Classic me?
I am.
I’m getting it now.
Dylan! D to the Y to the --
You’re just in time for the end of the game.
Come on. I’ll catch you up.
Come on, I don’t bite.
Kidding. Okay, see that guy? Tying run. He’s been stuck on second base forever. I think he’s gonna try and steal third. So, how’s it going with you and Haley?
Knock yourself out, brah.
He’s a little jumpy, isn’t he?
I thought we were past that. I’m all about taking it to the next level.
Yes, but the whole point of keeping it real is so that you can take it to the next level. Did you really not know that?
What are you talking about?
What? Are you kidding? Jay and I are total buds!

Jay and I are “buds” with kind of an invisible asterisk. He’s not a... talker. Or a hugger. Once he ran over my foot with his car. To be fair, he had just given up smoking. But, basically, we’re buds. imaginary asterisk) Asterisk.
Brought six friends.

I decided to make more of an effort with Jay. Our relationship’s always been stuck in that primal place where we started. He’s the old silverback protecting his females. Then this younger, stronger gorilla comes swinging in, beating his chest. Naturally the ape-ladies come running, presenting their nice scarlet behinds. Papa ape wants to stop all that, but he can’t. That’s just life. I’m not the enemy. The enemy is poachers.
Um...
Now can I try it?

I should get one of these. I’ve always loved planes. If my life had gone a little differently, I think I would have been a pilot. Hey, what would happen if you turned the remote off and then back on real fast?
So can you do a loop-de-loop?
No way. Can I try it?
Okay.
I can see why you like this, it’s so peaceful. I mean, the whole world disappears when you’re out here. I remember this one summer --
How does it go?
That sounds awesome! And then I get a turn at flying it?
Okay.
Is this far enough?
Okay!
You hit me.
I didn’t move!
I was in a plane crash.
No I didn’t. You did it on purpose.
Water...
Jay.
I didn’t.
Really?
This feels so right.
You’re very muscular.
Doesn’t he have big arms?
Dylan! Get in on this! GLORIA Everybody smile! JAY Don’t push it. FADE OUT. END OF ACT THREE

Listening.

Boom. Just like that, the whole day changed. It was game on. I knew it. She knew it. We both knew it.
I always take stairs two at a time. I don’t even think about it anymore. It’s muscle memory. The regular way would feel weird.

the universe) Why?!
